none: PAS CAM-DA0960: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Nummus, probably of Valens
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM ; D/ DN VALEN [...]

A copper-alloy nummus, probably of Valens. Mint is uncertain, AD367-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor dragging captive right. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads DN VALEN [...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.49g, diameter is 18.83mm
